name: Fire Bolt

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Ranged spell attack against creature or object; Fire dice and character-level scaling; ignite hit unworn/uncarried flammable object.

rules.text: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range.
Make a ranged spell attack against the target.
On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage.
A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn’t being worn or carried.
The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).
